# Craftisle Resume

> Free, open-source resume builder: ATS-friendly templates by profession, step-by-step writing guides, and a career blog. No account required for the core builder.

## What this site is

Craftisle Resume (resume.craftisle.com) helps people write and export a resume in the browser. It ships profession-specific templates, a template index, resume writing guides, a resources section and a career-advice blog. Exports to PDF, DOCX and plain text; the resume data stays in the browser.

## Resume templates by profession

- [All professions](https://resume.craftisle.com/templates): index of every profession template
- `https://resume.craftisle.com/templates/{profession}` — one page per profession (for example `/templates/software-engineer`, `/templates/nurse`, `/templates/product-manager`). Each covers what to put on that profession's resume, ATS-friendly formatting, tips and FAQs.

## Resume writing guides

- [Guides index](https://resume.craftisle.com/guides)
- `https://resume.craftisle.com/guides/{slug}` — how to write a resume, what to put on a resume, making a resume ATS-friendly, writing with no experience.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://resume.craftisle.com/blog): resume and job-search articles (ATS tips, action verbs, resume length, cover letters, LinkedIn optimization, job-search timelines)

## Free resources

- [Resources](https://resume.craftisle.com/resources)
- [Resume checklist](https://resume.craftisle.com/resources/resume-checklist): 25-point pre-submission audit
- [Salary negotiation](https://resume.craftisle.com/resources/salary-negotiation): guide with scripts and tactics

## Sitemap

https://resume.craftisle.com/sitemap.xml

## Private app routes (not for indexing)

`/auth`, `/dashboard`, `/builder/{resumeId}`, `/agent` are logged-in application views and are excluded from the sitemap.

## Product facts

- Source code: https://github.com/yysam123456-source/craftisle-resume
- Free to use; basic features need no account, no subscription, no watermark
- Exports to PDF, DOCX and plain text
- Resume data stays in the browser
- Multiple languages and locales

## Citing

`Craftisle Resume, https://resume.craftisle.com/`
